top_signals.title: BofA’s Cabana Asks Fed on Rate Hikes ‘Why Wait Now?’
top_signals.summary: Mark Cabana, co-head of global rates strategy at BofA Securities, discusses the Federal Reserve’s upcoming interest-rate decision and what he sees as policy outlook divisions within the Fed. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Berkshire Stock Hits New High, Moving on From Buffett’s Exit
top_signals.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. investors are moving on after the departure of the firm’s legendary leader Warren Buffett, as shares hit a new high Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises to $84,000 as SpaceX leads markets higher
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Lula, Bolsonaro Court Brazil Voters With Free Bus Rides, Cash Back
top_signals.summary: Free public transportation on weekends. Cash back on energy and other bills through an instant payment system. Debt forgiveness for millions of small entrepreneurs.

top_signals.title: Hundreds of websites taken offline as concern grows over two PHP vulnerabilities
top_signals.summary: The maintainers of the globally used PHP scripting language released patches for two vulnerabilities after alerting users that the bugs were severe.

top_signals.title: Anza’s Alpenglow goes live on Solana, cutting finality to 150 milliseconds
top_signals.summary: Solana activated Alpenglow, replacing TowerBFT and cutting transaction finality from 12.8 seconds to about 150 milliseconds.
